rue.definition:
n. European strong-scented perennial herb with grey-green bitter-tasting leaves; an irritant similar to poison ivy
n. leaves sometimes used for flavoring fruit or claret cup but should be used with great caution: can cause irritation like poison ivy
n. (French) a street or road in France
rue.translation:
n. 懊悔, 后悔, 芸香
v. 后悔, 悲伤, 懊悔

rue a bargain.translation: [经] 后悔而取消交易(契约)

rued.translation: v. 对…感到后悔( rue的过去式和过去分词 )

rueda.translation: [地名] [阿根廷、西班牙] 鲁埃达

rueful.definition: s feeling or expressing pain or sorrow for sins or offenses
rueful.translation: a. 悲伤的, 后悔的, 可怜的

ruefulness.definition: n. sadness associated with some wrong done or some disappointment

rueil-malmaison.translation: [地名] [法国] 吕埃-马尔迈松
